content_data.meeting_title: Q3 Innovation Portfolio Review: European Market Expansion
agenda_items: Analysis of Q3 budget variances for key strategic initiatives
Assessment of new market entry financial models (Central & Eastern Europe)
Discussion on funding allocation for next-phase R&D in sustainable real estate tech
Review of current innovation project financial performance
key_decisions: Agreed to commission a detailed cost-benefit analysis for the proposed blockchain-based property transaction platform.
Approved reallocation of unspent funds from Project 'Eco-Smart Urban' to Project 'Digital Twin Platforms'.
Endorsed the initial financial projections for market entry into Poland and Czech Republic, pending further due diligence.
attendees: Elena Petrova, Head of European Strategy
Isabelle Dubois, Director of Corporate Finance
Marcus Chen, Head of Digital Transformation
Dr. Kai Hansen, VP of Innovation & R&D
